name: Verify Lumina Healthcare Customer Account Creation
description: Ensures that the Lumina Healthcare account was successfully created in the system as an active customer.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE name = 'Lumina Healthcare' AND account_type = 'customer' AND active = 1;

name: Verify Creation of Lumina Implementation Coordination Group
description: Confirms that the support coordination group named "Lumina Implementation Coordination" was created and marked as an active support-type group.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_group WHERE name = 'Lumina Implementation Coordination' AND type = 'support' AND active = 1;

name: Verify Exactly Three Members Assigned to the New Coordination Group
description: Checks that the new "Lumina Implementation Coordination" group contains exactly three assigned.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM user_group_member ugm JOIN user_group ug ON ugm.group_id = ug.group_id WHERE ug.name = 'Lumina Implementation Coordination';

name: Verify One Manager from Installed Base Support Assigned
description: Validates that exactly one of the users added to the "Lumina Implementation Coordination" group is both a manager and originally part of the Installed Base Support team.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS manager_count FROM user u JOIN user_group_member new_g ON u.user_id = new_g.user_id JOIN user_group ng ON new_g.group_id = ng.group_id JOIN user_group_member ib_g ON u.user_id = ib_g.user_id JOIN user_group ibg ON ib_g.group_id = ibg.group_id WHERE ng.name = 'Lumina Implementation Coordination' AND ibg.name = 'Installed Base Support' AND u.role = 'manager';

name: Verify Two Non-Managers from Installed Base Support Assigned
description: Ensures that exactly two assigned users in the "Lumina Implementation Coordination" group are non-managers and originally members of the Installed Base Support team.

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_manager_count FROM user u JOIN user_group_member new_g ON u.user_id = new_g.user_id JOIN user_group ng ON new_g.group_id = ng.group_id JOIN user_group_member ib_g ON u.user_id = ib_g.user_id JOIN user_group ibg ON ib_g.group_id = ibg.group_id WHERE ng.name = 'Lumina Implementation Coordination' AND ibg.name = 'Installed Base Support' AND u.role != 'manager';
